entries.title: Developing high-resolution data to assess spatiotemporal patterns of meteorological drought in India (1981-2021)
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level CC license on publisher page before redistributing full text
entries.summary: 5 km-resolution SPEI drought analysis for India 1981-2021 using ERA5/CHIRPS; finds a significant decreasing SPEI (intensifying drought) trend in western Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, eastern UP, Maharashtra and northern Karnataka.

entries.title: The role of non-farm income and employment support in farmers' decisions on crop insurance
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Studies how non-farm income and employment support influence farmers' crop-insurance uptake decisions.

entries.title: Crop Insurance Policies in India: An Empirical Analysis of Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
entries.license: MDPI open access (CC-BY, per MDPI's standard journal policy — confirm on publisher page)
entries.summary: Empirical analysis of PMFBY crop insurance policy performance in India.

entries.title: Soil health and its relationship with food security and human health to meet the sustainable development goals in India
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Reviews the relationship between soil health, food security and human health in India in the context of the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

entries.title: Differential biochemical responses of seven Indian wheat genotypes to temperature stress
entries.license: BMC open access (CC-BY, per BMC's standard journal policy — confirm on publisher page)
entries.summary: Compares biochemical heat-stress responses across seven Indian wheat genotypes — relevant to heatwave impact on rabi wheat yield.

entries.title: Genome-Wide Association Study Reveals Genomic Regions Associated With Ten Agronomical Traits in Wheat Under Late-Sown Conditions
entries.license: Frontiers open access (CC-BY, per Frontiers' standard journal policy — confirm on publisher page)
entries.summary: GWAS study of ten agronomic wheat traits under late-sowing (delayed monsoon withdrawal) conditions.

entries.title: Assessment of irrigational suitability of groundwater in Thanjavur district, Southern India using Mamdani fuzzy inference system
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Assesses groundwater suitability for irrigation in Thanjavur district using a fuzzy-inference methodology; a template for a similar MP-district assessment if CGWB data is integrated.

entries.title: Hydrogeochemical processes, characterization and groundwater quality evaluation in Southwestern Punjab, India
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Groundwater quality and hydrogeochemistry study in southwestern Punjab, India.

entries.title: Detection of land use/land cover changes in a watershed: A case study of the Murredu watershed in Telangana state, India
entries.source: DOAJ (Watershed Ecology and the Environment, Elsevier)
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Land use/land cover change detection methodology for an Indian watershed, using remote sensing.

entries.title: Satellite based integrated approaches to modelling spatial carbon stock and carbon sequestration potential of different land uses of Northeast India
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Satellite-based modelling of carbon stock and sequestration potential across land-use types in Northeast India.

entries.title: Agriculture sector datasets
entries.license: Government Open Data License - India
entries.summary: Official Government of India open data catalog for the agriculture sector (yield, area, production statistics by state/district). Bulk API access requires a free data.gov.in API key (registration, not a per-request login).

entries.title: Agmarknet - Agricultural Marketing Information Network
entries.license: Government of India portal
entries.summary: Daily mandi (wholesale market) price portal maintained by the Directorate of Marketing and Inspection, Ministry of Agriculture. Web search is public/no-login; a stable no-key bulk API was not confirmed.

entries.title: PM-KISAN datasets on data.gov.in
entries.license: Government Open Data License - India
entries.summary: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi beneficiary/disbursement datasets catalogued on the Open Government Data platform. pmkisan.gov.in itself only offers individual beneficiary status lookup (not bulk data).

entries.title: Soil Health Card portal
entries.license: Government of India portal
entries.summary: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare portal publishing soil health card statistics by state/district/block. A confirmed bulk-download endpoint was not found; figures are presented via dashboards.

entries.title: India-WRIS - groundwater layers
entries.license: Government of India portal; unclassified CGWB data stated as freely downloadable
entries.summary: Water Resources Information System hosting CGWB groundwater level/quality data; exposes a WFS/geoserver interface for programmatic access to unclassified data.

entries.title: Central Water Commission - Water Resources Information System
entries.license: Government of India portal
entries.summary: CWC reservoir level and flood-forecast information system. No bulk no-login API confirmed as of this manifest's fetch date.

entries.title: National Disaster Management Authority - publications
entries.license: Government of India portal
entries.summary: NDMA publishes flood/drought/disaster guidance and situation reports as PDF publications. No unified bulk API for historical disaster records was found.

entries.title: PMGSY (rural roads) datasets on data.gov.in
entries.license: Government Open Data License - India
entries.summary: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana rural-road datasets catalogued on the Open Government Data platform. The OMMS project-monitoring portal (omms.nic.in) is dashboard-only as far as verified, no bulk API confirmed.

entries.title: Bhuvan - ISRO geoportal (land use/land cover)
entries.license: ISRO Bhuvan terms of use
entries.summary: ISRO's Earth-observation geoportal; exposes WMS/WFS services for various thematic layers including land use/land cover and water bodies. Some layers are open without login, others require registration -- verify per layer.

entries.title: Forest Survey of India - State of Forest Report
entries.license: Government of India portal
entries.summary: FSI publishes the biennial State of Forest Report (district-level forest cover) as a PDF document; geospatial layers are distributed via Bhuvan.

entries.title: Microbial consortia enhance wheat productivity, plant nutrition and soil fertility in Vertisols of Central India
entries.authors: Soumyajeet Pradhan, Soumyajeet Pradhan, N. G. Mitra, R. K. Sahu
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Sustaining wheat productivity while safeguarding soil health is a pressing challenge in intensive production systems, particularly in the nutrient-immobilizing Vertisols. entries.title: Spatiotemporal dynamics and policy impact on farmer suicides in Maharashtra, India
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Abstract Maharashtra has long faced a severe agricultural crisis, with a high number of farmer suicides, making it crucial to evaluate how government agricultural policies affect farmer suicides. entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page

entries.title: Evaluation of hydrogeochemical characteristics and groundwater quality in the quaternary aquifers of Unnao District, Uttar Pradesh, India
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: The present study has been carried out to assess the factors controlling the hydrogeochemical characteristics and groundwater quality in a part of Unnao district, Uttar Pradesh, India. entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Hydrochemical study was carried out in Madhuranthakam located near Chennai in Tamil Nadu, India with an objective of understanding the suitability of local groundwater quality for domestic and irrigation purposes. Twenty groundwater samples were collected in February 2002 and analysed for physical and chemical parameters. Groundwater in this area was found to be within the desirable Bureau of Indian Standards and World Health Organisation limits for drinking water. Ca-HCO3 was the dominant groundwater type. entries.title: Assessment of groundwater quality for drinking and irrigation purposes in arid areas of Rajasthan, India
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Abstract The quality of groundwater is poorly understood in the arid northwest part of Rajasthan, whereas it is the only source of drinking and irrigation and the residents consume it without any prior treatment. This study illustrates the qualitative analysis of groundwater and its suitability in the bulk samples collected from three different canal catchment areas. Most of the samples were identified for higher values of EC, TDS, TH and fluoride, therefore considered posing restriction to drinking use. entries.title: A systematic literature review of land use and land cover dynamics in Manipur, India
entries.license: DOAJ-indexed open access; confirm article-level license on publisher page
entries.summary: Abstract Understanding land use and land cover change (LULCC) is essential for analyzing human-environment interactions. Manipur, located in Northeast India, is particularly sensitive to LULCC due to its ecological diversity and increasing anthropogenic pressures. This study systematically reviews existing literature to examine the trends, drivers, and implications of Land use and land cover (LULC) dynamics in the region. entries.authors: Pinki Mondal, Trishna Dutta, Abdul Qadir, Sandeep Sharma
